blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – The Tambacan barangay council in Iligan City has offered free rides to the public, including students and employees, following the closure of Badelles Bridge for rehabilitation. Ma-e Labra, Tambacan barangay captain, told the Inquirer on the phone Tuesday that they deployed an Isuzu Elf and Toyota Innova to ferry passengers from Purok 1 near the entrance gate of Iligan City National High School in Poblacion. The vehicles are often used for baptismal or burial occasions, the official said.
